title: Bengaluru's Disappearing Lakes
gallery_text: Some of Bengaluru's lakes have been encroached on. Many are dried up, dead lakes.
description:
Historical legal lake boundaries (date unsure 👀) sourced from KSRSAC. This data was originally collected and digitized from older revenue maps.
https://data.opencity.in/dataset/lakes-and-ponds-in-bengaluru-district/resource/11617e96-5aa2-4f2d-8df3-89727b6a75f3

Current lake boundaries (2026) sourced from ATREE. Current legal boundaries of lakes.
https://data.opencity.in/dataset/map-lakes-streams-bengaluru-urban-within-bbmp-area/resource/0ab3a8a4-3b1a-4817-853e-376bce810aa7

I have also overlayed an image of the water outlines of the lakes from Google Earth. These shapes come from satellite imagery. Becuase it is an image overlay, I was unnable to correct its projection, hence the distorted map.
